full_description: use the right arm to grasp the pen leaning diagonally against the cube and lift the pen without targeting the support cube
schema: {A} identifies the pen, {B} identifies the support cube, and {a} identifies the arm used to grasp the pen
preference: single-right-arm active-spatial grasp task; the pen is the target and the cube is only a support object
instruction: Grasp the pen leaning against the cube using {a} and lift it.
Pick up the diagonally supported pen with {a}.
Lift the leaning pen without grasping the support cube.
